content.query: AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "ingestion_run_finished" | summarize runs = count() by state = tostring(Properties["state"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
content.title: Runs by final state per day

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ingestion.items.completed" | summarize items = sum(Sum) by operation = tostring(Properties["operation"]), state = tostring(Properties["state"]), outcomeCode = tostring(Properties["outcome_code"]) | order by items desc
content.title: Item outcomes by code

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.ingestion.queue.oldest_age", "docchat.ingestion.items.queued", "docchat.ingestion.items.running") | summarize value = max(Sum) by Name, priority = tostring(Properties["priority"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Queue age, queued and running items

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.ingestion.dispatcher.heartbeat_age", "docchat.ingestion.poison_queue.length") | summarize value = max(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Dispatcher heartbeat age and poison messages

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.ingestion.stage.duration", "docchat.ingestion.item.duration") | summarize meanS = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxS = max(Max), n = sum(ItemCount) by Name, stage = coalesce(tostring(Properties["stage"]), tostring(Properties["operation"])), methodKey = tostring(Properties["method_key"])
content.title: Stage and item duration

content.query: AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "ingestion_item_failed" | project TimeGenerated, runId = tostring(Properties["runId"]), itemId = tostring(Properties["itemId"]), operation = tostring(Properties["operation"]), stage = tostring(Properties["stage"]), outcomeCode = tostring(Properties["outcomeCode"]) | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Latest failed items

content.query: union (AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ingestion.scan.results" | summarize n = sum(Sum) by item = strcat("scan:", tostring(Properties["result"]))), (AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "scanner_canary_result" | summarize n = todouble(count()), lastAt = max(TimeGenerated) by item = strcat("canary:", tostring(Properties["result"])))
content.title: Scan results and the scanner canary

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.uploads.completed" | summarize uploads = sum(Sum) by outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]), errorCode = tostring(Properties["error_code"])
content.title: Uploads by outcome

content.query: AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("ingestion_dispatcher_restarted", "index_repointed", "physical_index_deleted", "ingestion_queue_send_failed", "ingestion_message_invalid") | summarize n = count(), lastAt = max(TimeGenerated) by Name
content.title: Dispatcher restarts, repoints, deleted physical indexes and message problems

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.ingestion.convert.duration", "docchat.ingestion.convert.pages") | summarize mean = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxValue = max(Max), n = sum(ItemCount) by Name, contentType = tostring(Properties["content_type"]), outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
content.title: Office conversions
